name: Fixture Dark Only
description: A test fixture: a single-mode dark scheme, for mode locking, system on a single-mode scheme, and the light high-contrast set print uses.

source.name: Nord, by Arctic Ice Studio and Sven Greb

provenance.attribution: The anchors are the reviewed prototype's nord dark anchors, from the Nord palette (nordtheme/nord, MIT).
provenance.derivation: anchor-v1 from one dark set of anchors.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the sets high-contrast-v1 derives from each base set, and print renders the light set.
caveats: A test fixture: it registers only when APPEARANCE_FIXTURES=1.
